commit.message:
feat: make mobile data entry first-class (keypads, Log in bottom nav, safe area)

Audited every tab at 375px. The logging flow was built desktop-first; this
lands the highest-impact mobile data-entry fixes:

- Weight/reps/sets inputs were type="text", so phones popped the full QWERTY
  keyboard. Add inputMode (decimal for weight, numeric for reps/sets) so the
  numeric keypad shows, and bump their touch height (py-2 -> py-3).
- The Log tab was missing from the mobile bottom nav (buried in the hamburger).
  Surface it centered — the primary daily action — for admins; public visitors
  still see the same four tabs.
- Add viewport-fit=cover + env(safe-area-inset-bottom) padding so the bottom nav
  isn't tucked under the home indicator on notched phones, and pad the scroll
  area so the last row of content clears the fixed nav.
